component.name: StreamProbe
component.script:
sub init() m.video = m.top.findNode("probeVideo") m.video.observeField("state", "onVideoState") end sub
' Re-entrant: launch args may arrive after init. sub onLaunchArgs() startPlayback(m.top.launchArgs) end sub
sub startPlayback(args as dynamic) if args = invalid then return
url = pickArg(args, "input_url", "url") if url = invalid or url = "" then return
format = pickArg(args, "input_format", "format") if format = invalid or format = "" then format = "hls"
content = createObject("RoSGNode", "ContentNode") content.title = "StreamProbe" content.streamFormat = format content.url = url
keySystem = pickArg(args, "input_drm", "drm") licenseUrl = pickArg(args, "input_license_url", "licenseServerURL") if keySystem <> invalid and keySystem <> "" then drmParams = { KeySystem: keySystem } if licenseUrl <> invalid and licenseUrl <> "" then drmParams.licenseServerURL = licenseUrl end if headerName = pickArg(args, "input_license_header_name", invalid) headerValue = pickArg(args, "input_license_header_value", invalid) if headerName <> invalid and headerName <> "" then drmParams.licenseReqHeaders = [ { name: headerName, value: headerValue } ] end if content.drmParams = drmParams end if
m.video.content = content m.video.setFocus(true) m.video.control = "play" m.top.probeState = "requested" end sub
function pickArg(args as object, primary as string, fallback as dynamic) as dynamic if args.doesExist(primary) then return args[primary] if fallback <> invalid and args.doesExist(fallback) then return args[fallback] return invalid end function
sub onVideoState() st = m.video.state m.top.probeState = st ' Mirror to console (port 8085) so the error can be captured without RTA. print "[StreamProbe] state changed "; st if st = "error" then m.top.probeErrorCode = m.video.errorCode m.top.probeErrorMsg = m.video.errorMsg info = m.video.errorInfo print "[StreamProbe] errorCode = "; m.video.errorCode print "[StreamProbe] errorMsg = "; m.video.errorMsg if info <> invalid then m.top.probeErrorInfo = formatJSON(info) print "[StreamProbe] errorInfo = "; m.top.probeErrorInfo end if end if end sub
